title: 第18章 台风天
novel_title: 七零老太随军，海岛养崽当家做主
content_zh:
虽然这顿饭一口气扯出去老远，但蔡老太依旧抓住了重点，饭后指挥赵玉兰打扫院子，“院子打扫干净，回头下雨了堵住门槛能接一波水。”

    赵玉兰还真差点忘了台风，应了声走几步回头看婆婆。

    婆媳俩同时拍大腿，又忘记还没有扫帚的事儿！

    魏建业：“行”

    意思就是标记上了，这活归他了。

    既然说到缺啥的事

    蔡老太想起之前兄妹三洗手的时候拿的是茶缸子，“还少个水瓢。”

    魏建业：“行”

    蔡老太这会踩着地跺跺脚。

    老家的院子是三合土，经年累月被踩出了包浆，接到的雨水很清澈。

    家属院的土虽然也是三合土，估摸着以前有探亲的来住过几回而已，这地面还没踩踏实了，一刮风就是一阵土。

    饶是回头下雨，能接到的雨水估摸着也浑浊，想洗衣服估摸着够呛。

    不用扫地也有很多的活儿，蔡老太对儿媳妇说：“咱们家现在有两个牛筋桶，两个搪瓷盆，少是少点，总比没有强，还有搪瓷杯啥的，能接多少是多少吧。”

    她扭头还得吩咐儿子，“你把水缸挪到院子里来。”

    水缸在屋檐下，虽然也不耽误接水，但会有瓦片味，保不齐还能冲下灰尘和鸟屎，白瞎下雨的机会了。

    夫妻俩双双应下。

    蔡老太看媳妇走路一瘸一拐就问：“玉兰，你脚咋了？”

    赵玉兰含含糊糊地说：“没事啊，新鞋有点磨脚。”

    她已经尽量表现得不明显啦。

    这一双塑料鞋两块五呢。

    也不是过年居然就添置了新鞋子，那她要还抱怨磨脚多不上道啊。

    魏建业不挪缸了，走过来弯腰说：“磨脚啊，你脱鞋我瞅瞅。”

    一家子盯着赵玉兰的脚丫子看。

    老天爷哦，都磨出血窟窿来咯。

    蔡老太看着都觉得疼，说：“别穿了，先养好脚再说。”

    赵玉兰还想再忍忍，鞋子磨松了就好了，穿新鞋总是要遭这一份罪的。

    魏建业心疼媳妇。

    今儿一大早上服务社买了鞋后就穿上了，到此时此刻也走了万多步了，老遭罪了。
content_en:
Although the meal was carried far away in one go, Mrs. Cai still grasped the key point. After the meal, she directed Zhao Yulan to clean the yard, "Clean the yard clean. When it rains, block the threshold to catch a wave of water."

Zhao Yulan almost forgot about the typhoon, so she responded and took a few steps to look back at her mother-in-law.

The mother-in-law and daughter-in-law slapped their thighs at the same time, forgetting that there was no broom yet!

Wei Jianye: “OK”

It means that it is marked and the job belongs to him.

Since we are talking about missing something,

Mrs. Cai remembered that when the three brothers and sisters washed their hands before, they took a teapot and said, "There is still a water ladle missing."

Wei Jianye: “OK”

Old Mrs. Cai would stomp on the ground and stamp her feet.

The yard of my hometown is made of Sanhe soil, which has been trodden out over the years, and the rainwater it receives is very clear.

Although the soil in the family courtyard is also Sanhe soil, I guess it has only been visited a few times by visiting relatives. The ground has not yet been stepped on firmly, and there will be a burst of soil when the wind blows.

Even if it rains later, the rainwater that can be collected will probably be muddy, which will be difficult to wash clothes.

There is still a lot of work to do without sweeping the floor. Mrs. Cai said to her daughter-in-law: "Our family now has two beef tendon buckets and two enamel basins. A little less is better than nothing. There are also enamel cups and other things. Let's take as many as we can."

She turned around and ordered her son, "Move the water tank to the yard."

The water tank is under the eaves. Although there is no delay in receiving water, it will smell like tiles. If it is not kept clean, dust and bird droppings will wash away, which will waste the chance of rain.

The couple both agreed.

Seeing her daughter-in-law walking with a limp, Mrs. Cai asked, "Yulan, what's wrong with your feet?"

Zhao Yulan said vaguely: "It's okay, the new shoes are a bit scratchy."

She tried to be as inconspicuous as possible.

This pair of plastic shoes costs two and a half yuan.

It's not like she actually bought new shoes during the Chinese New Year, so it would be unreasonable for her to complain about grinding her feet too much.

Wei Jianye stopped moving the vat, walked over and bent down and said, "Wash your feet. Take off your shoes and let me take a look."

The whole family stared at Zhao Yulan's feet.

Oh my god, it's all bloody.

Mrs. Cai felt pain just looking at it and said, "Don't wear it anymore. Let's take good care of your feet first."

Zhao Yulan still wanted to endure it a little longer. It would be fine if her shoes were worn loose. Wearing new shoes would always lead to this.

Wei Jianye felt sorry for his wife.

I bought shoes at the service center this morning and put them on. By now I have walked more than 10,000 steps, and I am always suffering.
